caption_L1: This bar diagram is named Which , if any , of the following measures do you think the British Government should take to contain the Coronavirus (COVID-19) ?. A linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 can be found along the y-axis, labeled Mar 26 to Mar 27. The x-axis measures Response.
caption_L2L3: The majority of respondants believe that drastic measures must be taken to contain COVID-19. The majority of respondants believe that stopping sporting events and allowing employees to work from home are the correct measures to be taken. Less than half of respondants believe that free masks should be provided.
